parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete all tags that are attached to the resource. This parameter is valid only when the **TagKey** parameter is not set in the request. The default value is **false**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: This parameter is required to detach tags from topics and group IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. This is an enumeration. Supported resource types:

- **INSTANCE**

- **TOPIC**

- **GROUP**

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: A list of tag keys of the resource.
